title: 第22章 李西雄获利离场，亏钱贪婪，盈利恐惧的心里
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
李西海有这么一个亲祖祖。

    可以说高枕无忧。

    别说当年的养育之恩 ，李西海的二爷及后代要认。

    就是辈分摆在那里，也极为吓人。

    后辈敢违逆的，几乎没有，怕是那位李大功副市长，虽然贵市长，但在李西海祖祖面前，也不敢不敬。

    “他李家的人丁是真旺啊。”宋锦想到西字辈都那么多，不由感叹道。

    “何止是旺，从华字辈算下来，在江云县就有上千口子人，这还没算，出去的李姓，还有当年华字辈上一辈的人，上上一辈的。”

    宋锦好笑道：“这都多远了，都快追到老黄历了。”

    “你别以为远就没关系了。”

    宋建兴抖了抖烟灰，道：“李家有个族谱，怎么传下来的，什么字辈的都记录的很清楚。”

    “能传下族谱的家族，往上推一推，都是有功名官位的。”

    “李家村的这一房，其实也不是嫡支，旁支庶出的一房。”

    他抽了一口，道：“现在，邻县、邻市的李姓，生下儿女后，第一件事就是来李家村上族谱记录。”

    “男子成婚要记录，女子出嫁也要记录。”

    “李家村的祖祠，五年更新一次，只要是去祠堂捐了钱的李姓，不管多少都有一本族谱。”

    宋锦张了张嘴，不知道说什么，最后想了想，道：“他们还搞的这么封建。”

    “你懂什么。”

    宋建兴严肃道：“这种话，绝对不能在李家人面前说。”

    “人家就是有这本族谱，什么关系都清清楚楚，遇到问题，遇到事，就能顺着族谱找上去。”

    “我们宋家是外来姓，人家才是本地坐地龙。”

    “李家看起来就窝在江云，最大的是常委副市长，但真要有事，能靠着族谱，找遍天下李姓。”

    “宗族这关系，平时是看不到摸不着的，但在老一辈眼里，很多时候是不考虑利害，考虑的是宗族血脉。”

    宋建兴再次提醒，道：“你跟李西海能不能成，我不过问，但最好不要得罪。”

    “万一，我是说万一，能跟李西海成呢？”宋锦问道。

    宋建兴明显一愣，“你看上了？”

    “我只是说万一。”宋锦道。

    “我说了不过问。”

    “随你。”

    宋锦看了看时间，道：“该出门了。”

    “中午晚上我都不回来吃，你跟妈说一声。”

    宋建兴起身追问道：“你干什么去？”

    “你猜？”

    “你个死丫头……。”

    ……

    “西海哥！”

    软绵略带撒娇的语气，在包厢响起。

    李西海与李西朋同时摘下耳机，回头一看。
content_en:
Li Xihai has such an ancestor.

    It can be said that you can sit back and relax.

    Not to mention the kindness of raising him back then, Li Xihai's second grandfather and his descendants must recognize it.

    Even the seniority is there, it is extremely scary.

    Few of the younger generation would dare to disobey, probably even Vice Mayor Li Dagong. Even though he was dear to the mayor, he would not dare to be disrespectful in front of Li Xihai's ancestors.

    "The Li family is really prosperous." Song Jin couldn't help but sigh when he thought about how many Westerners there were.

    "Not only is it prosperous, there are thousands of people in Jiangyun County counting from the Huazi generation, and that's not even counting the people with the surname Li who went out, and the people from the previous generation of the Huazi generation, and the generation before them."

    Song Jin said with a smile: "It's so far away, I'm almost catching up with Lao Huangli."

    "Don't think it doesn't matter if you are far away."

    Song Jianxing shook the cigarette ashes and said, "The Li family has a genealogy. How it was passed down and what generation it belongs to are all clearly recorded."

    "Families that can pass down the family tree, push up the family tree, all have famous and official positions."

    "This house in Lijiacun is actually not a direct descendant, but a concubine from a side branch."

    He took a sip and said, "Now, when people with the surname Li from neighboring counties and cities give birth to children, the first thing they do is come to Lijia Village to record their genealogy."

    "A man's marriage must be recorded, and a woman's marriage must be recorded."

    "The ancestral temple in Lijia Village is updated every five years. Anyone with the surname Li who has donated money to the ancestral hall will have a genealogy no matter how old they are."

    Song Jin opened his mouth, not knowing what to say. Finally, he thought about it and said, "They are still so feudal."

    "What do you know?"

    Song Jianxing said seriously: "Such words must not be said in front of the Li family."

    "People just have this family tree, and all the relationships are clear. If they encounter problems or problems, they can follow the family tree to find them."

    "Our Song family has a foreign surname, and they are local dragons."

    "The Li family seems to be nestled in Jiangyun. The eldest is the Standing Committee and Vice Mayor. But if something really happens, I can rely on the genealogy to find the Li surname all over the world."

    "The relationship between clan is usually invisible and intangible, but in the eyes of the older generation, they often don't consider the interests and benefits, but only consider the blood of the clan."

    Song Jianxing reminded him again, "I don't care whether you and Li Xihai can make it work, but it's best not to offend."

    "What if, I mean what if, we can succeed with Li Xihai?" Song Jin asked.

    Song Jianxing was obviously taken aback, "Are you attracted to it?"

    "I'm just saying it in case." Song Jin said.

    "I said I won't ask questions."

    "As you wish."

    Song Jin looked at the time and said, "It's time to go out."

    "I won't come back for lunch or dinner, please tell mom."

    Song Jianxing stood up and asked, "What are you doing?"

    "What do you think?"

    "You damn girl..."

    …

    "Brother Xihai!"

    Ruanmian's slightly coquettish tone sounded in the box.

    Li Xihai and Li Xipeng took off their headphones at the same time and looked back.
